def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    if not kwargs:
        kwargs = {}

    section = []
    section.append('   REMEDIATIONS')

    if not is_using_api_key():
        total_vulns = sum(
            data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            for pkg_remediations in remediations.values()
            for data in pkg_remediations.values()
        )
        total_pkgs = len(remediations)
        
        content = f"\n  {total_vulns} vulnerabilit{'y' if total_vulns == 1 else 'ies'} was reported in {total_pkgs} package{'s' if total_pkgs != 1 else ''}. For detailed remediation & fix \n  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. \n"
        section.append(content)
    else:
        content = '\n'
        for pkg_name, pkg_remediations in remediations.items():
            for spec, remediation in pkg_remediations.items():
                vulns_found = remediation.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
                version = remediation.get('version', '')
                recommended_version = remediation.get('recommended_version', None)
                other_recommended = remediation.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
                closest_secure = remediation.get('closest_secure_version', {})
                more_info_url = remediation.get('more_info_url', '')

                content += f'-> {pkg_name} version {version} was found, which has {vulns_found} vulnerabilit{"y" if vulns_found == 1 else "ies"}\n'

                upper = closest_secure.get('upper', None)
                if upper:
                    content += f'   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {upper}\n'

                content += f'{" " * 78}\n'

                if recommended_version:
                    other_msg = ''
                    if other_recommended:
                        other_versions = ', '.join(str(v) for v in other_recommended)
                        other_msg = f' Other versions\n   without known vulnerabilities are: {other_versions}'
                    content += f'   We recommend updating to version {recommended_version} of {pkg_name}.{other_msg}\n'

                content += f'{" " * 78}\n'

                content += f'   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit\n'
                content += f'   {more_info_url}\n'
                content += f'   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.\n'
                content += f'{" " * 78}'

        section.append(content)

    section.append('+' + '=' * 78 + '+')

    return section


def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if not text and not start_line_decorator and not end_line_decorator:
        width = columns
        line = start_line_decorator + ' ' * (width - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)) + end_line_decorator
        return line

    width = columns
    
    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=max(1, width - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)),
        initial_indent=indent,
        subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False,
    )

    if color:
        raw_text = click.unstyle(text)
    else:
        raw_text = click.unstyle(text)

    wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(raw_text)

    if not wrapped_lines:
        wrapped_lines = ['']

    if max_lines is not None:
        wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]

    result_lines = []
    for line in wrapped_lines:
        pad_length = width - len(start_line_decorator) - len(line) - len(end_line_decorator)
        if pad_length < 0:
            pad_length = 0
        result_line = start_line_decorator + line + ' ' * pad_length + end_line_decorator
        result_lines.append(result_line)

    result = '\n'.join(result_lines)

    if color:
        result = click.style(result, fg=color)

    return result
